jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Retail Media
jobs.description:
Overview

Live the experience
. From professional empowerment to continual learning opportunities. From ongoing investment in new and emerging technologies to a career of self-determination. At Ulta Beauty, our tech team is critical to our scalability—and is recognized that way. We’ve been defined as a “mature start-up.” A place where interdepartmental exposure, open doors, and genuine collaboration is ubiquitous. Where challenges come fast and furious, requiring agility, mental dexterity, and creativity. Where our passion for better solutions
drives us and is core to who we are.

We’re engineering for the future of retail, and it’s no-holds-barred. But for those motivated by continual change and ambiguity, by superior leadership, by whip smart colleagues who will press you daily for your very best, you’ll find that virtually nothing’s impossible at Ulta Beauty.

THE IMPACT YOU CAN MAKE:

Ulta is seeking a highly accomplished Director of Engineering
to own the technology vision, strategy, delivery and operational excellence for Ulta’s retail media network: UB Media. This leader will build and scale the engineering organization responsible for delivering solutions spanning Audience creation, Identity resolution, Campaign activation, Ad serving, Measurement & attribution, Reporting platforms, Advertiser APIs, Campaign management, and privacy-safe data collaboration including clean rooms, partner data exchanges, APIs, and secure data-sharing services. Your success will enable UB Media’s growth objectives and establish UB Media as the premier brand advertiser platform.

YOU’LL ACCOMPLISH THESE GOALS BY:

Engineering Leadership & Technical Strategy:

Provide strategic leadership for the Retail Media Network engineering organization, including ownership of platform architecture, engineering standards, technical roadmaps, and long-term scalability. Drive technology innovation while ensuring reliable, secure, and high-performing solutions that support business growth.

Vision/Strategy:

Develop and execute multi-year engineering and platform roadmaps aligned to Retail Media Network business objectives. Partner with Product, Data & Analytics, Digital, Marketing, and Enterprise Technology leaders to prioritize investment decisions and accelerate delivery of strategic capabilities.

Organizational Leadership & Cultural Champion:

Build, lead, and develop high-performing engineering teams. Champion agile delivery, product-centric operating models, continuous improvement, and a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and engineering excellence.

Business & Stakeholder Relationship Management:

Serve as the primary technology leader for Retail Media Network initiatives, partnering with executive stakeholders, vendor partners, and cross-functional teams. Translate business objectives into scalable technology solutions and proactively identify opportunities to improve advertiser, brand partner, and customer experiences.

ESSENTIALS FOR SUCCESS:

B.S. in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Engineering, or related technical discipline.
M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or related field preferred.
12+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, platform engineering, product development, or related technology leadership roles.
5+ years of experience leading engineering managers, technical leaders, and cross-functional technology organizations.
Experience leading retail media networks, large-scale digital platforms, advertising technology, media technology, eCommerce, or related technology ecosystems.
Proven track record defining and executing technology strategies aligned with business objectives.
Strong experience building and scaling cloud-native applications and distributed systems across hybrid and cloud environments.
Demonstrated expertise in solution architecture, system design, enterprise integrations, and platform modernization.
Proven success leading agile engineering organizations and delivering complex technology initiatives.
Experience managing vendor relationships, SaaS platforms, and third-party technology partnerships.
Strong understanding of data platforms, APIs, analytics, measurement frameworks, and digital advertising technologies.
Excellent executive communication, stakeholder management, and organizational leadership capabilities.
Demonstrated ability to attract, develop, and retain high-performing engineering talent.
Experience within Retail Media Networks, Advertising Technology (AdTech), Marketing Technology (MarTech), eCommerce platforms, or digital media organizations preferred.

The pay range for this position is $143,000.00 - $230,000.00 / Year with the opportunity for eligible associates to earn additional compensation pursuant to the Company’s bonus plan. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, shift, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Full-time positions are eligible for paid time off, health, dental, vision, life and disability benefits. Part-time positions are eligible for dental, vision, life, and disability benefits. For additional information concerning our benefits, visit our Benefits and Career Development page: https://learn.bswift.com/ulta

About

At Ulta Beauty
(NASDAQ: ULTA), the possibilities are beautiful
. Ulta Beauty is the largest North American beauty retailer and the premier beauty destination for cosmetics, fragrance, skin care products, hair care products and salon services. We bring possibilities to life through the power of beauty each and every day in our stores and online with more than 25,000 products from approximately 500 well-established and emerging beauty brands across all categories and price points, including Ulta Beauty’s own private label. Ulta Beauty also offers a full-service salon in every store featuring—hair, skin, brow, and make-up services.

We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest records, conviction records, or other criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of any applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the New York City Fair Chance Act.

jobs.title: Director, Software Engineering – Acute Devices
jobs.description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.

We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.

As the Global Software Leader for Acute Products/ Devices, this role is responsible for leading multi-site device software engineering team for Acute Care products by defining and driving software strategy and implementation and delivering to all Acute Care product lines. As the Global Device Software Leader for Acute Care product lines of Vantive, works in collaboration with commercial, systems, program management, Quality & Regulatory functional leadership teams to build and execute on product strategy, roadmaps and delivery plans.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Own product-line software strategy and roadmaps for device software for all acute products; aligning with business and product strategy and therapy needs.
Lead Acute global device software team, including functional managers and technical leaders.
Lead defining and implementing technology and software architecture strategy working with Acute device software leaders and in collaboration with systems leaders
Lead Acute global device software team in building execution plans and driving execution to deliver to the product roadmaps and releases across all Acute product lines.
Create, effectively communicate, and realize vision and strategy for the organization that aligns with the business and customer needs.
Establish an organization structure that ensures clear accountability and operational excellence.
Develop and mentor high-performing managers and technical leaders; build succession plans and communities of practice across global sites.
Provide strategic planning leadership for resource staffing and project execution with proactive management of technical and project risk to ensure delivery of business commitments
Leverages deep knowledge of technology/process/therapy domains, user needs, hazards, risk, and business targets and budgets to drive solutions and product design realization.
Management of technical and project risk to ensure delivery of business commitments.
Drive post-market software change management strategy, field data analytics, and reliability improvements with contained risk and minimal therapy disruption.
Embrace and embed agile ways of working in support of a fail-fast-learn-fast culture and enabling continual improvement.
Foster a collaborative work environment with strong working relationships within and across businesses and functions, and with strategic external partners.
Maintain current knowledge of relevant Quality System Regulations and other regulatory requirements related to research and development (medical product development, design, safety, Cyber Security) to ensure compliance in all research, development, data collection and reporting activities.

Qualifications

Significant experience in Electro-mechanical devices and device software engineering.
Understanding of global regulatory requirements for medical devices; risk and reliability concepts for development; and the need to deliver quality products and/or processes.
Significant experience leading a globally distributed team and working in a global matrix environment.
Strong team building and talent management skills, and the ability to motivate team members to achieve goals.
Proven experience in driving product specific and overall portfolio strategy, specific to software technology, in a global business.
Must possess strong knowledge of scientific/technical disciplines and solid knowledge of related disciplines such as regulatory, quality, and/or product development.
Recognized internally and externally as expert in functional area.
Must be a strategic, innovative problem solver, and have strong influencing and communication skills.
Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills across Clinical, RA/QA, Systems, Operations, and suppliers.

Education and/or Experience

Bachelor’s degree in electrical/computer/software engineering (Master’s preferred). Experience in medical devices or other safety‑critical electromechanical domains (e.g., aerospace, industrial controls, automotive) required; medical device experience strongly preferred.

jobs.title: IT Engineering and Strategy Transformation Senior Manager
jobs.description:
Engineering Transformation-Strategy Growth and Transformation Technology Senior Manager - AI & Engineering/EaaS

Join our AI & Engineering team in transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Engineering as a Service provides complete design, implementation, and technology operations, leveraging our core engineering expertise. We transform engineering teams, modernize technology, and deliver complex programs with a product engineering approach. Our flexible delivery models-traditional teams, pools, or pods-are tailored to each client's needs, offering engineering-led advisory, implementation, and operational capabilities to accelerate innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/15/2026.

Work You'll Do

As a Strategy Growth and Transformation Senior Manager, you are an accomplished Digital Transformation Lead who drives strategic change and delivers exceptional value for commercial sector clients. This role will serve as a trusted advisor to Technology, Operations and Strategy executives, working on complex transformation initiatives. The successful candidate will have deep engineering transformation experience, which includes a strong program delivery foundation and a passion for developing innovative solutions. You will lead globally dispersed teams (primarily across the US, India, and Mexico) to successfully deliver strategy and downstream transformation engagements. You will be part of engagement planning which includes defining deliverables and milestone structure, as well as overseeing engagement delivery which includes managing the team that will build deliverables - it will be your job to ensure the team delivers on time and with high quality. In addition, you will assist in managing engagement risk and on-going engagement economics and managing client expectations proactively. You will serve as a coach for junior practitioners, serving in the role as a "coach" and providing input and guidance into the future staffing needs.

Qualifications

10+ years' experience in the commercial professional services IT consulting sector working on large scale IT engineering/transformation projects with hands-on depth in technology around application development and custom built applications.
Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, engineering or a related field
5+ years' experience selling, running and leading large scale transformation programs in a commercial environment with a focus on technology.
10+ years' experience in technology and operational transformation efforts
Experience in operating model transformation, agile delivery, leading global teams across borders
A strong understanding of the fundamentals of engineering transformation with the ability to successfully articulate technology concepts to both a business and a technology audience with depth and accuracy.
Experience working in a multi-vendor environment and with third parties
Extensive team leadership experience which should include managing people, projects, clients and financials.
Experience using AI to streamline business processes and create efficiencies.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship now or at any time in the future.

Ability to travel up to 50% of the time, based on the work you perform and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred

Master's degree, preferably in computer science, information technology, engineering or business
Ability to quickly learn and deliver on analogous technologies not previously worked on;
Industry recognized technology certifications - AWS, Cloud, Google, Claude and others.

Wages and Salary

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $163,400 to $322,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
